name: B10-0383/2025 (S&D) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of five Cypriot citizens held in the occupied areas of Cyprus since 19 July 2025. It says they were arrested without good reason, held without bail, and tried in a military court, which it argues breaks their right to a fair trial. The Parliament asks the European Union's top diplomat to push Türkiye to end the detentions. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU's top diplomat to press Türkiye for the five people's release.
- **Who it affects:** Five named Cypriot citizens held in the occupied areas, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The EU's top diplomat is asked to step up diplomatic efforts with Türkiye.
